About this session

Slow down, connect with rhythm, and experience the calming sound of the handpan in an intimate, guided circle. The session covers the basics of rhythm, scale and touch, and by the end, everyone plays something that feels like music. The session closes with a short live performance from Arpit.

Terms & Conditions

Booking and payment

When you book, you are agreeing to everything on this page. We collect your name, contact details, and booking information so we can run the session and keep you updated. Payments are handled securely by Razorpay, so we never see or store your card details.

Cancellations and refunds

Once you book, your spot is confirmed and the ticket cannot be cancelled or refunded. Please be sure of your date before you pay. The only exception is if we cancel the entire workshop, in which case you get a full refund.

If we need to change something

Now and then a schedule may shift for reasons outside our control, like venue or weather issues. If that happens we will let you know as early as we can. If we ever have to call off the whole workshop, you get a full refund.

Sending someone in your place

If you can't make it, you're welcome to pass your spot to a friend. Just send us their name beforehand so we know who to expect.

What to expect

This is a beginner friendly session, so no experience is needed. You'll be sitting on mats while you play, so wear something comfortable. Please arrive on time so we can start together.

The handpans

Handpans are provided during the session, so you don't need to bring your own. They're delicate instruments, so please handle them with care. If you damage an instrument, you'll be responsible for the cost of repair or replacement.

Observer pass

If you'd like to come along without joining in, an observer pass is available. Observers can watch the workshop, soak in the atmosphere, and enjoy the live handpan concert at the end. Handpans are not provided and the observer pass does not include taking part in the workshop activities.

Photos and video

We photograph and film our sessions, including wide shots of the whole workshop, and use them on social media and to promote future workshops. By booking, you agree that we may film and photograph the session, including you, and use that footage. If you have any concerns, have a word with us before the session.

Admission and conduct

We reserve the right of admission. If anyone behaves in a way that's unsafe or disruptive to others, we may ask them to leave, and that decision rests with us.

Your belongings

Please look after your personal things. We can't take responsibility for any loss or damage to items you bring along.

A note on health

The session is gentle and hands-on, but you take part at your own comfort. If you have any health condition we should be aware of, please tell us in advance so we can look after you.
